title: Metadata packet test queries: phased LFB targets and lateral field bleed
description: These claims set test queries for the archive's metadata packets and the Lateral Field Bleed score each is forecast to reach, phased from weeks to more than a year after deposit. They come from the packets on autonomous warfare (#100), the death drive (#101), provenance after AI (#725, #1190, #729), the MPAI disambiguation packets (#103 to #105), and Sappho, Phase X, the semantic economy and Alexanarch and from the LFB protocols paper (#726) and the packet specification v2.0 (#1677). Most are forecasts and unbuilt tests: desired compositions, ring-by-ring expectations, spillover between linked packets and phrase-fingerprint workflows; #100 and #725 forecast that broad ring 4 to 5 queries stay with incumbent sources. The page also holds unrelated claims on a geocoded basin, PER validation, process provenance, a work plan and an adoption interval.

### Phase 3 — Edge Activation (1-3 months)

Adjacent queries begin to surface the packet as a source.

Correct intervention: Satellite reinforcement (Protocol I). Build bridge satellites in adjacent fields' native vocabulary. Run measurement audits.

Do not: declare victory yet. Source presence (Score 2-3) is not field bleed.

### Phase 4 — Field Capture (3-12 months)

The concept becomes structurally necessary to category answers.

Correct intervention: Disambiguation defense (Protocol G) and adversarial defense (Protocol N). Competitors begin to notice and either cite or contest.

Do not: ignore hostile redefinitions. They harden quickly.

claims.resolves_by: by dated observation of the event, state or reception forecast, inside its window if it names one; for a speculative specification (E), by the outcome its mode names — the thing appearing, built by anyone (design specification); the conditions it names coming to hold (scenario); present uptake or retrieval (performative anticipation); a fictional report or a vision is recorded, not scored
claims.registered_title: The Living Academy: Alexanarch, Function by Function — Mantle object with Metadata Packet for AI Indexing (EA-MPAI-ALEXANARCH-01 v0.4)
